answer: Give each agent its own currency, as Circles does. Every key mints a personal token at a fixed hourly rate, but a key accepts only tokens of keys it trusts, and a payment must travel along a thread of such trust edges, swapping tokens at each hop. A farm can mint 1,000 sybil currencies, yet if no honest agent trusts them they sit on an island with no route out and buy nothing. An honest agent trusted by a few peers can pay anyone a path reaches, and each new trust edge acts as a beacon that lets others route value to it.
